# tools: every tool sidecoach ships, with its invocation and exit contract

<!-- GENERATED by sidecoach/scripts/generate-tool-index.ts - do not hand-edit.
     Every count and every membership claim below is derived from bin/sidecoach.js and
     bin/ on disk, because the hand-written version of this table shipped two false
     claims at once. `npm run build` fails if this file drifts from the code. -->

Load this when a flow or a verb reaches for a tool, when you need an exit contract before
acting on a result, or when you are about to hand-roll something sidecoach already ships.

## Read the exit codes before you act on a result

Every tool here is FAIL-CLOSED and the contracts are not interchangeable. **A nonzero
exit never means clean.** In particular `3` means the check could not be performed, so a
`3` with no findings is unverified rather than passing, and treating it as a pass is how a
scan that never ran gets reported as a clean bill of health. This is a real difference
from the tools that exit 0 when they could not do their job.

## Entry points (2) - on PATH after install

### `sidecoach`

The verb resolver. Resolves a verb or a retired alias to its flow chain and prints the plan that would run. Full flow EXECUTION needs a session context, so this is a faithful resolver and dispatcher, not a second flow engine.

```
sidecoach <verb> [target] | sidecoach list | sidecoach help [verb]
```

Exit: 0 resolved/listed, 1 unknown verb, 2 usage or the compiled orchestrator is missing

### `sidecoach-monitor`

The engine entry point the skill invokes. Runs a flow chain and RENDERS the executive report itself (`renderedReport` in --json). Print that string verbatim on a text surface; the `guidance` and `checklist` fields drive your own execution and are never pasted at the user.

```
sidecoach-monitor "<utterance>" --json
```

Exit: 0 ran, non-zero the run did not complete

## Standalone tools (15)

Of these, 7 are enumerated by `sidecoach list` and `sidecoach help`, and 8 are not (`sidecoach-artifacts`, `sidecoach-build-report`, `sidecoach-daemon`, `sidecoach-detect`, `sidecoach-doctor`, `sidecoach-floor`, `sidecoach-present`, `sidecoach-taste-check`) - those are reached by a hook, a module require, or nothing at all, and each row says which.

Flow-invoked, derived from `src/` rather than asserted: `sidecoach-detect`, `sidecoach-doctor`, `sidecoach-drift`, `sidecoach-image`, `sidecoach-preauthor`. Every other tool here is run by you or by the user, never automatically.

### `sidecoach-artifacts`

_not listed by the resolver_

Artifact-listing helper. Currently reached by nothing - see the note under Dead weight below.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-artifacts.js
```

Exit: see --help

### `sidecoach-build-report`

_not listed by the resolver_

BuildReport CLI. Covered by a test but reached by no flow, resolver entry or hook - see the note under Dead weight below.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-build-report.js
```

Exit: see --help

### `sidecoach-daemon`

_not listed by the resolver_

Background runner for the monitor, used by the session-start wiring.

```
bash <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-daemon.sh
```

Exit: 0 started, non-zero could not start

### `sidecoach-deck`

_listed by the resolver_

Present drawn directions as a Markdown or rich-HTML pick list for the user to choose from. The user picks by responding; this tool does not decide.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-roll.js | node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-deck.js --surface text|rich
```

Exit: 0 presented, 2 usage

### `sidecoach-detect`

_not listed by the resolver | flow-invoked | reached by /sidecoach audit_

The detection engine behind /sidecoach audit. Four lenses: static-ban (named absolute bans over raw source), static-check (the product rule registry), objective (rendered WCAG), subjective (rendered taste). It FAILS CLOSED - a lens that did not run is never counted as clean, so a partial scan with zero findings exits 3 rather than 0.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-detect.js <target> [--no-render] [--render-url <url>] [--quiet] [--list-rules]
```

Exit: 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 usage or IO error, 3 inconclusive

### `sidecoach-doctor`

_not listed by the resolver | flow-invoked | reached by /sidecoach doctor_

Report which sidecoach capabilities are DISCOVERABLE, REACHABLE and VERIFIED, and which are dead weight. Catches a capability that ships but is named in no loadable document, a capability nothing invokes, and a loadable document that contradicts the registry it describes. Exit 3 means a check could not run, so it is not a pass.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-doctor.js [--json] [--quiet] [--surface <dir>]
```

Exit: 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 usage or unreadable input, 3 inconclusive

### `sidecoach-drift`

_listed by the resolver | flow-invoked_

Report custom-property tokens that drifted off the project's committed DESIGN.md baseline (off-system colours, radii, spacings, easings, durations), each named with its value and file. A missing baseline fails closed and never reports 'no drift'.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-drift.js <project-dir> [--json]
```

Exit: 0 no drift, 1 drift, 2 usage, 3 cannot assess

### `sidecoach-floor`

_not listed by the resolver_

The craft-floor check: the quality floor and absolute bans that apply immediately before UI is edited. Wired as a hook rather than invoked by hand.

```
wired from claude/hooks/sidecoach-craft-floor.sh
```

Exit: see --help

### `sidecoach-image`

_listed by the resolver | flow-invoked_

Generate a raster asset AND verify the produced bytes - geometry, format, actual render, transparency, and real WCAG contrast for the text that will sit on it. Offline by default; live spend is opt-in. A generator that does not check its own output is how a broken or blank asset ships as artwork.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-image.js generate --prompt "<brief>" --out hero.png
```

Exit: 0 produced and verified, non-zero see --help for the per-mode contract

### `sidecoach-palette`

_listed by the resolver_

Emit a DESIGN.md palette from brand OKLCH anchors, printed ONLY when every required contrast pair passes. A palette you are holding is a palette that already cleared WCAG; exit 1 means the palette does not exist yet, not that it needs a second look.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-palette.js --brand <brand.json>
```

Exit: 0 clean, 1 a required contrast pair FAILED, 2 usage, 3 inconclusive

### `sidecoach-preauthor`

_listed by the resolver | flow-invoked_

The render-before-build gate. From a brief JSON it renders board.html plus mock.html and runs the rendered-audit engine over the mock, returning a fail-closed verdict BEFORE any component code is written. Exit 3 means it could not assess, which is not permission to proceed.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-preauthor.js --brief <brief.json> [--out-dir <dir>]
```

Exit: 0 proceed, 1 BLOCKED, 2 usage, 3 inconclusive

### `sidecoach-present`

_not listed by the resolver_

The executive-report renderer. Turns a flow run into the deliverable blocks, before/after tables and per-rule craft notes the user reads. Required by the monitor rather than run by hand, and listed here because a report layer nothing documents is a report layer nobody can debug.

```
required by bin/sidecoach-monitor.js (require('./sidecoach-present'))
```

Exit: n/a - a module, not a CLI

### `sidecoach-refs`

_listed by the resolver_

Refresh the bundled reference systems on demand, merging and preserving your /curate captures so local captures survive an upstream refresh. `--check` is a pure read.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-refs.js [--check | --apply]
```

Exit: 0 ok, 2 usage, 3 upstream, 4 validation, 5 io, 10 drift, 70 internal

### `sidecoach-roll`

_listed by the resolver_

Draw a design direction from the deck so the choice does not come from your own ranking. A single ranked list is deterministic, which is how every run converges on the same page. `--seed` makes a draw reproducible, `--exclude` prevents a re-roll repeating a direction, `--model-top` ranks your own instinct last on purpose.

```
node <sidecoach-repo>/bin/sidecoach-roll.js [--seed <uint32>] [--exclude <id,...>] [--model-top]
```

Exit: 0 drew, 2 usage, 3 the deck is exhausted

### `sidecoach-taste-check`

_not listed by the resolver_

The anti-pattern ban sweep that runs on an edited .html or .css inside a project carrying a DESIGN.md. A SUBSET of /sidecoach audit, not a replacement for it.

```
wired from claude/hooks/sidecoach-taste-gate.sh
```

Exit: 0 clean, non-zero a ban fired

## Dead weight, named on purpose

`sidecoach-artifacts` and `sidecoach-build-report` ship in `bin/` and are reached by nothing - no flow spawns them,
no other tool requires them, no hook wires them, and the resolver does not list them. They are
listed here rather than quietly omitted because an undocumented orphan gets rediscovered every
few months and re-investigated from scratch. `sidecoach doctor` reports them as `capability-unreached`
every run; the two honest resolutions are to wire them or to retire them.
